Deal 70.80000000000001-76.80000000000001 physical damage. Against a target at or below 10% health, replace Strength scaling with its maximum health before defenses and other damage effects.

"The shield does not guard one – it guards all." Grants all allies a Protective Shield equal to 35.25% of your Max HP for 2 rounds. While shields are active, you gain +20 Armor and +20 Magic Resistance.
"When steel and will collide, even mountains tremble." A powerful strike that damages a single enemy for 46.6-51.6 damage and stuns the target for 1 turn.

Damage all enemies for 52.6-59.6 damage. One cast-level roll has a 50% chance to attempt a 1-turn stun on each enemy. If at least 2 stuns apply, gain +20 Armor and Magic Resistance until the end of battle.
Protect one ally, including yourself, for 1 round: reduce incoming damage by 50% and reflect 65.25% back to the attacker. Does not stack with Thorn Carapace (chooses the stronger effect).
A bladestorm rhythm spell that damages a single enemy for 52.5-58.5 damage twice.
Unyielding spirit, unbroken flesh. Cleanses all debuffs and grants +20 Magic Resistance & +20 Armor for 2 rounds. If HP is below 30%, also restores 10% Max HP on cast.
Channel for 2 turns, unable to act or move. Then deal 160% Intelligence damage to surviving original enemy targets still on the opposing team. Movement cannot dodge the discharge.
"Some see only one motion – but the blade has already fallen twice." Grants the player a second action in the next round.
